comment: Scoped npm audit exceptions, matched on the exact (id, package, workspace) tuple. Every entry needs approved_by (not PENDING), approved_on, approval_source, a reason and review_by (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 60 days after approval). Invalid, unapproved or expired entries fail the gate.

entries.reason: No fixed node-forge release (affected <= 1.4.0, latest 1.4.0). Reached only via expo -> @expo/cli -> @expo/code-signing-certificates (2 edges below @expo/cli, not marked dev in the lockfile). Only CLI/build paths: no app imports of node-forge, expo-updates not installed. Not excluded: reachability inside Expo CLI code paths (e.g. code-signing commands) on developer/CI machines.
